messages:
jen-docs: heads up — main build failed after the examples PR, linkcheck complaining about a missing fragment for /sdk#example_repo(v2). log excerpt below:

```
ERROR: Fragment '/sdk#example_repo(v2)' not found (docs/sdk/README.md:120)
```

jen-docs: the offending line in docs/sdk/README.md looks like this:

```markdown
### Example repo (v2)
See repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/example_repo(v2)/blob/main/README.md
```

sam-platform: ah, parens in raw URL — that will break the fragment/linkcheck. Docusaurus slugify for the heading becomes `example-repo-v2`, but the literal URL keeping `(v2)` trips the checker. encode the parens or use the slugified anchor instead.

maria-docs: also noticed a secondary issue: the code sample near the bottom used triple tildes (~~~python) which our markdown-to-mdx pipeline treats inconsistently across the two doc builders. switched to triple backticks in my local patch and it fixed a parser hiccup.

jen-docs: thanks — i pushed a tiny PR that: 1) replaces the raw paren URL with the anchored link `/docs/sdk#example-repo-v2`, 2) URL-encodes the upstream raw link as fallback (`example_repo%28v2%29`), and 3) converts `~~~` fences to "```". PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

ci-bot: Re-run queued for PR #4321 — build started (linkcheck + site build).

devon-eng: small alternative: you can add an explicit MDX heading ID so the target is unambiguous, e.g. `## Example repo (v2) {#example-repo-v2}` — avoids depending on slugify behavior.

maria-docs: +1 for the explicit `{#id}` approach when we want to be deterministic. i'll update the README in the same PR to include that.

sam-platform: makes sense. also left a comment in PR suggesting we add a unit test for linkcheck on headings with punctuation so this doesn't regress.

jen-docs: CI came back green, linkcheck passed, merged. thanks all :tada:

maria-docs: follow-up: added a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about prefering backticks for fences and using explicit heading IDs for paren-heavy titles. tiny follow-up PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330

sam-platform: nice tidy-up :thumbsup:

jen-docs: closing the thread — will monitor next prod deploy for any residual anchor warnings.
